stage: Local dashboard prototype with authenticated remote-access support; deployment and real-device validation are installation-specific
hostingDecision: Keep the frontend, API, and private data on a Mac. Optional Tailscale Serve or Cloudflare Access and Tunnel provide authenticated phone access.
primaryJob: Help the user recover context, triage what needs attention, choose a next action, and retain a broad project overview.

triageExploration.status: Illustrative first test, not an agreed priority policy
requirements: Show the reason for suggested priority
Keep broad project overview one tap away
Do not infer urgency from recent chat activity alone

directions.Focus: A calm home view centered on decisions and reviews, with recent changes alongside.
directions.Overview: A project library showing recognizable projects, their state, and their next action.

visualPrinciples: Warm neutral surfaces and a restrained forest-green accent
Status labels paired with color and iconography
One main action per project, with context available on demand
No invented completion percentages, streaks, or urgency
Preserve user control over priorities and deferment
Same terminology and controls on phone and laptop

accessibilityTargets.reference: WCAG 2.2 AA as a baseline, supplemented by universal design and cognitive accessibility guidance; no conformance claim yet
accessibilityTargets.primaryControlSize: At least 44 by 44 CSS pixels as our preferred touch target
accessibilityTargets.reflow: No horizontal scrolling of the main interface at 320 CSS pixels
accessibilityTargets.textResize: Retain content and functionality at 200 percent text size
accessibilityTargets.input: Keyboard, touch, and pointer access; no drag-only or hover-only action
accessibilityTargets.focus: Visible focus, stable reading order, no focus trap
accessibilityTargets.motion: Respect reduced-motion preferences; no continuous or decorative animation
accessibilityTargets.statusUpdates: Preserve reading position and focus; announce meaningful changes without reordering the active view

requiredStates: Mac disconnected with timestamped saved view
prototypeInteractions: Sort a stable batch of up to five conversations
Edit suggested short names, project, recap, and next step
Track, keep as reference, save as idea, or finish explicitly
Skip without changing records and undo the last choice
Reveal source context and draft evidence
Set aside for later and undo
Capture an idea without a deadline
Read a saved metadata view while disconnected
productionToolDirection: Responsive React app, custom CSS design tokens, and React Aria for complex accessible controls; keep native HTML controls where sufficient.
nextValidation: Owner login and signed-out HTML/API denial on the configured HTTPS route
Real phone and cellular use, including cached reopening while the Mac is off
User feedback on triage labels, density, and project overview
Assistive-technology checks before any conformance claim

implementation.home: Tracked ongoing work only; compact project overview before sorting invitation and attention queue.
implementation.storage: Local SQLite with independent user-confirmed task fields and read-only conversation snapshots.
implementation.connection: Up to 20 recent non-archived local Codex conversations, refreshed every five minutes.
implementation.phone: Optional private HTTPS through Tailscale Serve or a Cloudflare Access-protected named tunnel. Configuration, availability, and device validation are installation-specific.
notYetImplemented: Reliable running/idle state from the desktop process
remainingValidation: Owner login and signed-out HTML/API denial on the configured HTTPS route
Real phone and cellular use, including cached reopening while the Mac is off
User feedback on triage labels, density, and project overview
Assistive-technology checks before any conformance claim
implementation.library: Needs sorting, Reference, and All saved. Unsorted/reference items do not inflate active project counts.
implementation.sorting: At most five records per session. Separate suggested fields and source context. Explicit reversible classification, conflict comparison, and preserved unsaved drafts.
implementation.suggestions: Optional reviewed assistant drafts are imported separately from confirmed fields. New records receive conservative starter drafts; source changes mark suggestions stale. No background model calls. No private draft data is included in source.
completedChecks: 88 Python server, authentication, and startup tests
Synthetic fixtures cover sorting, Undo, conflicting edits, unsaved drafts, and disconnected controls
Copied-database migration checks preserve existing task fields
Isolated Chrome fixture verifies saved-view reopening after HTTP 503 and a stopped origin, disabled mutations, and reconnection
Reflow checks at 320, 390, and 1280 CSS pixels

privateDomain.configurationScope: Per-installation setup; no account state, credentials, operational deployment status, or private data is published
privateDomain.hosting: Mac hosts the API, database, and built frontend. Cloudflare Access and a named Tunnel provide authenticated HTTPS without exposing a listening port on the Mac’s network interface.
privateDomain.ownerAccess: Origin verifies a signed JWT with exact issuer, application audience, expiration, RSA signature, and owner email. The tunnel route also enables Protect with Access.

routeRequirements.host: Preserve the configured public hostname or set httpHostHeader to it

privateDomain.offline: A previously visited trusted browser may reopen a dated, read-only metadata snapshot when the Mac or connection is unavailable. First-time devices and cleared caches require the Mac online. Edits stay disabled until reconnection.
privateDomain.cacheBoundary: The snapshot excludes full conversation excerpts, draft evidence, and mutation tokens. The app-shell cache excludes authentication pages and private API responses. Each website address has a separate cache.
privateDomain.dns: Before any nameserver migration, reconcile the full authoritative inventory and preserve existing website, mail, verification, subdomain, and DNSSEC settings. Automatic discovery does not prove completeness.
setupOrder: Prepare the domain and identity provider
Create an entire-hostname Access application and exact-owner Allow policy
Configure origin JWT verification while retaining loopback binding
Create a named tunnel and protected route with the expected Host header and non-chunked request bodies
Start the guarded connector and verify signed-out denial, owner login, cellular access, and offline recovery

validation.browserFixture: HTTP 503 and stopped-origin cached reopening, disabled mutations, reconnection, and 320/390/1280 CSS-pixel reflow
validation.deploymentVerification: Required for each installation; automated checks do not establish live remote access or actual phone compatibility

designFocus: Triage levels for what needs attention alongside a broad overview; expect testing and iteration.
